stratified_failure_mechanisms.interpretation: Post-hoc descriptive stratification, not a preregistered causal test; full evaluation metrics and the 1935-failure main denominator are unchanged. Exact adjacency checks only face-pair adjacency, not complete B-Rep topology or boundary geometry.
